name: TeamStarWolf - The Zero-Day Trade and Its Fallout (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 5 ATT&CK for ICS techniques that the ATT&CK pages for WannaCry (S0366), NotPetya (S0368) and Bad Rabbit (S0606) list, from case-studies/ZERO_DAY_MARKET_EVENTS.md. Each comment names the event and the study's source numbers. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK page ties the technique to an event in the study, 75 an ATT&CK software record related to the event but not dated to it.
